key_insight: Across the pseudo-boiling line, strong supercritical property gradients make vortex vorticity evolve far from classical Oseen diffusion, with additional viscous mechanisms becoming dominant.
engineering_relevance: This matters for supercritical-fluid equipment and CFD models because local temperature and pressure can create reverse vorticity and significantly alter swirl, mixing, and circulation.
method: Axisymmetric vortex column in supercritical CO2
Core temperature and ambient pressure varied near critical conditions
evidence_signal: The abstract reports axisymmetric simulations comparing hot/cold vortex cores at different near-critical pressures and identifies three extra viscous mechanisms beyond diffusion that reshape vorticity.
watch_item: Results are for low-Re, axisymmetric configurations of supercritical CO2, so direct use in fully 3D or higher-Re flows should be done cautiously.
paper_title: Dynamics of a vortex column of supercritical fluid across the pseudo-boiling line
